description: Step 1 of 2 to order: checks a basket of one or more menu items against the bakery's ordering rules. Saves nothing and makes no link. Returns the lane (same day on Toast, or catering on Shopify), the priced lines, the subtotal, any problems, and the dates and times the bakery can serve. Rules it applies: closed Mondays and blocked dates; Toast = only counter-menu items, up to 6 piroshki and pinoyshki (other items not limited), pickup, today while open or scheduled up to 14 days ahead with a time in that day's hours; catering = 3 days' notice for up to 24 full-size or 4 dozen bite-size piroshki and pinoyshki (other items not limited, pickup), a week ahead (by Saturday) for more, any delivery and custom cakes; delivery within 15 miles on orders over $100 or with a cake of $75 or more. The result may list 'Still needed' questions: combo_offer (a combo, in combo hours), sold_out_choice (what to do if a piroshki is sold out, for a later day) and cake_details (what is still undecided about a custom cake).

channel.description: Optional. 'today' = the counter menu on Toast: same day, or a scheduled pickup up to 14 days ahead (up to 6 full-size, pickup only, paid on Toast); 'catering' = ordered 3 or more days ahead, paid on Shopify. Left out, the basket and date decide: catering is preferred from 3 days out when every item is on the catering menu.

date.description: The date as YYYY-MM-DD ('today' also works). Work it out from the customer's words using today's date in Seattle (Pacific time). If their words could mean two dates, like 'next Friday' said earlier in the same week, ask them which before calling. Needed for catering and for a Toast pickup on a later day.

fulfillment.description: Default pickup. Delivery is catering, week-ahead only.

items.description: What to order. Use item names exactly as get_menu or search_menu gave them.

backups.description: Toast orders, with if_unavailable 'closest': up to 3 counter-menu piroshki or pinoyshki the customer would take instead, in order of preference.

cake.description: Only on the decorated cake (see cake_options): what was decided with the customer. Leave out what is not decided yet.

card.description: A card to go with the cake.

design.description: The design concept the customer agreed to.

flavor.description: Vanilla, Chocolate, Red Velvet, Ube, or the custom flavor asked for.

guests.description: How many people; picks the size.

recipient.description: Who it is for (with their age, for a birthday).

combo.description: Toast orders, piroshki and pinoyshki, when the pickup time is in combo hours (Tue to Fri, 11 am to 4 pm): 'small' = fries + a 12oz drink, 'large' = large fries, borscht + a drink, 'none' = the customer said no. check_order offers it (combo_offer) with each item's prices and drinks.

combo_drink.description: The combo's drink, as check_order listed it (like '12oz Coke' or 'Small Juice'). Default: any 12oz soda.

if_unavailable.description: Toast orders, piroshki and pinoyshki only: what the bakery does if this one is sold out when the order is made. 'closest' (default) swaps in the closest piroshki, 'remove' leaves it out, 'cancel' cancels the order. Worth asking for a scheduled day, since the counter menu changes.

note.description: Optional note for this line, like a cake inscription.

size.description: Catering sizes: 'full' (default), 'dozen', 'half dozen' or 'individual' (bite-size). Same-day items are always 'full'.

staff_tip.description: Toast orders: the tip for the bakery staff in whole dollars, shared by the staff who bake, pack and hand over the order. 0 (the default) unless the customer picks one; offer $1, $3 or $5 or any whole amount.

time.description: 12-hour time like '1:00 pm'. Needed for catering and for a Toast pickup on a later day.

zip.description: Delivery ZIP code (delivery is within 15 miles).

name: check_order

date_choices.description: Present when the date asked for could mean either of these; ask the customer which.

cake.description: The cake's flavor, message and design, in words, or empty.

combo.description: The line's combo upgrade, in words, or empty.

if_unavailable.description: The line's backup choice on Toast, in words.

ok.description: True when the order is allowed as asked.

soft.description: True when something is still needed (a date, a time) rather than broken.

staff_tip_cents.description: The tip for the bakery staff, 0 when none.

subtotal_cents.description: Before tax, with the staff tip; the checkout page shows the final total.

tip_offer.description: Toast orders: the staff tip choices in whole dollars and the suggested one.

today.description: Today's date in Seattle, like 'Thursday, September 24'.

title: Check an order
